context.content: Since Christmas is approaching, I feel like it is appropriate for me to construct a list of changes I want to see on Pokémon Home. ​ I don't dislike Pokémon Home in general. I think the fee is reasonable. I love the size comparison in the Pokedex. But there are so many things that must be rectified: ​ **- Allow GTS and Wonder Box on the Switch version** I hate that if I want to use the GTS or Wonder Box feature, I have to go through a rigorous process from depositing Pokemon from the game on Switch, use Phone to trade, then deposit the traded Pokemon on Switch into the game. It is too tedious and unnecessary. **- Fix the texture of Pokemon on the display screen for the mobile version** I don't even know why this isn't the case in the first place. I can count the pixels of some Pokemon for crying out loud. You'd expect the highest grossing franchise to have polished models, but no. The lack of refining is just preposterous. **- Filter Pokemon by the games they are from** After the Go connectivity was introduced, they are numerous lv.20 legendaries on the GTS. Why shouldn't we be allowed to filter the GTS by which game they are from. **- Sort by Box on the mobile version** Should've been instituted in the first place. I can't express how miffed I am for the inconsistency between the mobile and switch versions. I also hate the fact that I have to sort the Pokemons I transferred from Go everytime. **- Search Pokemon on the Switch Version** Seriously, I can't find my one particular Joltick among 3000 or so Pokemon. **- Unlimited friend trade** Why can we only trade 10 Pokemons a day TPC? Why? **- Add box in between boxes** Pretty self-explanatory. Will be a great change. I am not going to replace boxes one by one. **- Pokemon interaction on the mobile version** Something like Pokemon refresh. I love the idea of "Pocket Monster" coming to fruition, as they are literary in your pocket. Being able to carry my companion on my phone and play with it will be awesome. **- More customization** The wallpaper concept is neat. It reward you for registering different assortment of Pokemon. Perhap something like theme change would be nice. ​ There you go, that's my wishlist, but also kind of a rant. I think Pokemon Home has a lot of untapped potential. It is a flawed system, but it could be better.
